en-US.prompt: A RAG answer is wrong although the generator follows the supplied context. Which first metric most directly tests whether the evidence was available to the generator?
en-US.explanation: If relevant evidence is absent from the retrieved set, generation quality cannot repair that retrieval failure. Recall@k isolates that stage.
en-US.takeaway: Evaluate a RAG pipeline by stage before blaming the model.

knowledge_card.why_it_matters: It separates retrieval failures from generation failures.
knowledge_card.interview_angle: Describe a stage-wise RAG evaluation plan.
knowledge_card.common_pitfall: Using answer quality alone to diagnose retrieval.

distractor_explanations.A: Style does not show whether evidence was retrieved.
distractor_explanations.C: Length is not evidence coverage.
distractor_explanations.D: Throughput is a serving metric, not retrieval quality.

zh-CN.prompt: 一个 RAG 回答错误，但生成模型确实遵循了提供的上下文。哪项指标最直接检验生成器是否拿到了所需证据？

options.text: 相对相关文档的 retrieval recall@k

zh-CN.explanation: 若相关证据没有进入检索结果，生成质量无法弥补检索缺失。recall@k 能隔离这一阶段。
zh-CN.takeaway: 先按阶段评估 RAG，再归因给模型。

knowledge_card.summary: 检索 recall 衡量证据是否可用。
knowledge_card.why_it_matters: 它区分检索失败与生成失败。
knowledge_card.interview_angle: 说明如何设计分阶段的 RAG 评估。
knowledge_card.common_pitfall: 只用最终答案质量诊断检索。

distractor_explanations.A: 文风不能说明是否取回证据。
distractor_explanations.C: 长度不是证据覆盖。
distractor_explanations.D: 吞吐量是服务指标，不是检索质量。

en-US.prompt: An assistant wins an offline benchmark but users abandon it in production because it confidently acts on ambiguous requests. What production evaluation addition is most useful?

options.text: Log ambiguity, clarification rate, and harmful-action rate with human review

en-US.explanation: The observed failure is behavior under ambiguous real requests. Production traces and reviewed safety outcomes expose it.
en-US.takeaway: Offline accuracy is not a complete product evaluation.

knowledge_card.why_it_matters: Distribution and incentives differ from static benchmarks.
knowledge_card.interview_angle: Name leading indicators for unsafe agent behavior.
knowledge_card.common_pitfall: Treating a benchmark win as launch evidence.

distractor_explanations.A: More of the same benchmark may miss ambiguity.
distractor_explanations.C: Temperature is not an evaluation method.
distractor_explanations.D: Feedback removes the signal needed to diagnose abandonment.

zh-CN.prompt: 一个助手在离线基准上表现很好，但线上用户因它会自信地处理含糊请求而流失。最有用的线上评估补充是什么？

options.text: 记录歧义、澄清率和有害动作率，并人工复核

zh-CN.explanation: 问题发生在真实含糊请求下的行为；线上轨迹和审核后的安全结果才能暴露它。
zh-CN.takeaway: 离线准确率不是完整的产品评估。

distractor_explanations.A: 更多同类基准未必覆盖歧义。
distractor_explanations.C: 温度不是评估方法。
distractor_explanations.D: 移除反馈会失去诊断流失的信号。

en-US.prompt: You predict next-week churn. A feature records whether the support team offered a retention discount during that same next week. Why must it be excluded?

options.text: It leaks future information unavailable at prediction time

en-US.explanation: The feature is created after the prediction decision point, so validation would overstate deployable performance.

knowledge_card.why_it_matters: It creates models that fail after deployment.

knowledge_card.common_pitfall: Splitting rows randomly while ignoring time.

distractor_explanations.A: Category type is not the core issue.
distractor_explanations.C: Cardinality does not make it leakage.
distractor_explanations.D: Storage cost is unrelated to validity.

zh-CN.prompt: 你要预测下周流失。一项特征记录支持团队是否在该下周提供过留存折扣。为什么必须排除它？

en-US.prompt: A risk model assigns 0.8 probability to many cases, but only about 50% of those cases occur. Which statement is correct?

options.text: It is overconfident in that probability region

en-US.explanation: Predicted 80% with observed 50% means probabilities are systematically too high there.
en-US.takeaway: Calibration concerns probability meaning, not only ranking.

knowledge_card.summary: A calibrated 0.8 bucket occurs about 80% of the time.
knowledge_card.why_it_matters: Decisions and thresholds consume probabilities.
knowledge_card.interview_angle: Separate calibration from AUROC.
knowledge_card.common_pitfall: Assuming strong ranking implies trustworthy probabilities.

distractor_explanations.A: Observed frequency contradicts calibration.
distractor_explanations.C: Ranking can still be useful despite miscalibration.
distractor_explanations.D: Recall cannot be inferred from this fact.

knowledge_card.summary: 校准的 0.8 分桶约有 80% 会发生。

distractor_explanations.C: 失校准时排序仍可能有用。
distractor_explanations.D: 不能由此推出 recall。
